svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.28.1.2 Lath and Reinforcing
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.28 STUCCO

g.text: Lath on any substrate but masonry, (1)

svg.text: Stucco lath or reinforcing is used to attach
stucco to any substrate other than masonry.
Stucco lath or reinforcing is used to attach
(a) the masonry is soft-burned tile or brick of
less strength than the stucco, or (b) the masonry
surface is not sound, clean and sufficiently
rough to provide a good key.
Stucco applied over masonry chimneys is
B reads Sentence (2) the other way round: masonry that is neither (2)(a) nor (2)(b). Coat build-up and masonry pattern are schematic.
